About our Brand and Products we sell:  At traveling Bags we sell quality Luggage and travel good, Travel related gifts and home good too.  
If you love travel we have the products make travel Better, Safer and stay on Budget. We sell many products that are just better than the items normally found on social media sites, Items making flash in the pan sales videos.  We sell Quality Products that don't break and fail the first time  Returns of our products is rare about 8%.  We have multi lines of Luggage, Bags and travel accessories that have true Lifetime Warranties and are considered the best in the travel world. Most importantly they are considered the Best by people who don't get paid to sell things.

What are the best affiliate Channels for our items: 

  • Highly Recommended

    • Travel bloggers

    • YouTube travel creators

    • Travel gear review sites

    • Instagram / TikTok travel influencers

    • SEO content sites

    • Comparison shopping

    • Email newsletters

    • Travel forums

What are some our Brands You Should Know About:

  • Briggs & Riley*
  • Victorinox *
  • Davek Umbrellas*
  • Nocs - Binoculars, & Monoculars
  • Osprey Backpacks & Luggage*
  • Sockwell Compression Socks
  • Mac-In-A-Sac coats & outerwear
  • Travelon - Security Bags & Travel accesories
  • Baggallini - Bags & Luggage
     * Luxury Bonus comission rate of 12% on these items

What makes us different:  We are experts in luggage and bags.  not just employee assigned to sell you something at a big box store.  No a giant online retailer who doesn't care about you except for you credit card number.  What makes us different is customer service!  Customers are not numbers.  We have traditional values, offer rewards for loyal customer sand in additional to online sales we have a full service storefront location.  Lastly we are different because we service & repair the bags and luggage we sell, and many other brand too.  

How affiliates can earn: We have a robust affiliate plan percentage, including monthly bonus for sales goals achieved. 
The monthly reward level may seem high but our average order size is nearly $200 with some of our most common items priced individually at over $700 Dollars. The goals are there to motivate you, but are realistic and attainable month after month.

How to promote us: You know what to do, but we feel it is important to know that Selling Travel and Travel Goods is mainly about women.  from 18 to 80 ladies are our best customers, and will be yours too.

Other information: In addition to our affiliate program make sure you take advantage of a second way to earn.  
Our rewards program is also very robust to reward frequent customers.  You can sign up for free and it also has a referral program where you earn points.  Points turn into discounts, and other rewards for any travel items you may need.  By promoting Both Programs you potentially earn twice for the same customer
